preconditions.description: The number of cities n must be between 2 and 100,000.
The number of roads m must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= n and x != y for x, y in roads)
preconditions.description: Each road must connect two distinct cities within the range of 1 to n.

postconditions.description: The output must be the minimum number of separate cities after the reform.
